title: Stock Price Dataset
description: End-of-day stock price records, one object per symbol per trading date.

StockPriceRecord.title: Stock Price Record
StockPriceRecord.description: OHLCV data for a single ticker on a single trading date.

symbol.title: Ticker Symbol
symbol.description: Exchange ticker symbol for the security.

date.title: Trading Date
date.description: The trading date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

open.title: Open Price
open.description: Price of the security at market open.

high.title: High Price
high.description: Highest traded price during the session.

low.title: Low Price
low.description: Lowest traded price during the session.

close.title: Close Price
close.description: Price of the security at market close.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Total number of shares traded during the session.

adj_close.title: Adjusted Close Price
adj_close.description: Close price adjusted for splits and dividends.
